claims.text: RelayNest retries failed webhooks after 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes, and 2 hours.

claims.text: To recover an exhausted webhook delivery, fix the receiving endpoint.

citations.quote: Fix the receiving endpoint, then choose Replay delivery in the delivery log.

claims.text: Choose Replay delivery in the delivery log to create a new delivery attempt with the original event ID.

citations.quote: Replay creates a new delivery attempt with the original event ID.

claims.text: Receivers must deduplicate by event ID to avoid processing duplicate events.

citations.quote: Store processed event IDs and make duplicate event handling idempotent.

answer.proposed_note: To recover an exhausted webhook delivery, fix the receiving endpoint and use Replay delivery in the delivery log to create a new delivery attempt with the original event ID. Receivers must deduplicate by event ID to avoid processing duplicate events.
